name: dither-text
title: Dither text
description: Display text whose letters are filled with a dithered gradient or noise, kept as real, selectable text.

name: dissolve-text
title: Dissolve text
description: Text that dissolves in, and out, through the levels of a Bayer matrix, by character, word or line.

name: scramble-text
title: Scramble text
description: A decode effect that cycles glyphs and settles into the final text without shifting the layout.

name: dither-number
title: Dither number
description: An animated, Intl-formatted counter whose tabular digits roll or dissolve into place.
